## About
Body Rocks Paint & Body is a complete auto body repair facility on Main Street in Watauga, Texas. We handle the whole job, from minor dents and dings to bringing a car back to pre-accident condition, on foreign and domestic vehicles alike.
We've built our reputation on honesty and integrity, and our goal is to get your vehicle back on the road quickly and efficiently at the best value we can. We try to make accident repair as hassle-free as possible, with direct insurance billing, towing service and car rental.
Drivers have given us a 4.8 rating across 249 Google reviews. Stop by the shop on a weekday or give us a call, and we'll take a look.

## Services
- Collision repair and automotive painting: Collision repair and paint work for all makes and models, from small dents and dings to getting your car back to pre-accident condition.
- Paintless dent repair: Dent repair without repainting, a good fit for hail damage. One customer said the guys worked magic on his hail-damaged truck.
- Auto glass repair and replacement: Cracked or chipped windshield? We repair rock chips and replace windshields so you can get back on the road quickly.
- Alloy wheel repair: A cost-effective way to fix curb rash, nicks and scrapes instead of replacing expensive wheels.
- Upholstery: Upholstery work for the inside of your car, truck or SUV.
- Interior and exterior detail: A full interior and exterior detail to bring back that showroom shine.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We work on both foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: Is there a warranty on glass work?
A: Yes. Our glass work comes with a written lifetime warranty, and we work with most insurance companies. Give us a call for the full warranty details.
